# v0.4.4 — Settings and drop-downs fixed in the desktop app; a pumpkin for Halloween

## What's changed

- **Right-click Settings works in the desktop app.** Right-clicking TheOne's main chat entry and choosing Settings now opens TheOne's page in DSH's Settings dialog in the desktop app too; before, it did nothing there and only worked in the browser.
- **Drop-downs match DSH.** Every drop-down in TheOne (model, routing and linkage choices in Settings; "Move to…", workspace, linked chats, merging and adding links in the topic workspace) opens a dark menu in DSH's own style instead of the system's white list. Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, Home and End work, and near the bottom of the window the menu opens upward. Action menus such as "Move to…" show their prompt on the button only, not as a ticked choice.
- **Main chat no longer sticks on "Opening TheOne main chat…".** Clicking the main chat entry again while main chat was still opening could leave the opening page up with nothing behind it. It now finishes opening, and a click elsewhere in the meantime is respected.
- **A pumpkin for Halloween.** On 30 and 31 October the main chat entry wears a soft, see-through pumpkin behind TheOne's ring-and-dot mark. The rest of the year it looks as before.

Validation: type checks and the full automated suite (421 tests, including repeated clicks on main chat and the Halloween dates) pass on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, and the plugin archive builds.

## 中文

- **桌面版右键「设置」能打开了**：在主聊天入口上右键选「设置」，桌面版现在也会打开 DSH 设置弹窗里的 TheOne 页。以前只在浏览器里有效，桌面版点了没反应。
- **下拉框和 DSH 一致**：TheOne 里所有下拉框（设置页的模型、路由、联动选项，话题工作区的「改到…」、工作区、关联会话、合并、添加关联）都换成了 DSH 风格的深色菜单，不再弹出系统的白色列表。支持方向键、回车、Esc、Home 和 End，靠近窗口底部时向上弹出。「改到…」这类操作型下拉框，提示文字只显示在按钮上，不再作为带勾的选项出现。
- **主聊天不再卡在「正在打开 TheOne 主聊天…」**：主聊天还在打开时再点一次入口，之前可能停在打开页上不动。现在会继续打开完成；这期间点了别处，也不会被拉回来。
- **万圣节的南瓜**：10 月 30 日和 31 日，主聊天入口的圆圈加点后面会多一个半透明、毛茸茸的南瓜，其他日子保持原样。

验证：在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 上类型检查和全部自动化测试（421 项，含反复点击主聊天和万圣节日期）通过；插件包构建正常。
